programs.name: Expressive Labeling
programs.programObjective: Independently label familiar foods and actions across people and settings.
programs.teachingInstructions: Present one picture at a time, wait five seconds, follow the assigned prompt hierarchy, and reinforce independent labels.
programs.description: Independently label familiar foods and actions across people and settings.

targets.name: Expressive Food Items
targets.description: Names foods shown on picture cards.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Show a food card and ask 'What is this?'
targets.masteryCriteria: At least 8/10 independent labels for 3 sessions

targets.name: Label Everyday Actions
targets.description: Names actions without an echoic prompt.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Show an action picture and ask 'What is happening?'

targets.name: Food Preference Observations
targets.description: Record the client's own words and context.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Offer two snack options and wait for a choice.

programs.baseline: 4 of 10 food cards named without prompts on 2026-09-15.

programs.name: Playing with Toys
programs.programObjective: Build sustained independent play and reciprocal peer play.
programs.teachingInstructions: Offer a choice of materials; start timing on independent engagement and record each scheduled observation interval.
programs.description: Build sustained independent play and reciprocal peer play.

targets.name: Independent Block Play
targets.description: Seconds of uninterrupted independent play.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Place the building blocks on the mat and say 'You can build.'
targets.targetInstructions: Stop timer for prompts or disengagement.

targets.name: Turn Taking in Board Games
targets.description: Observe unprompted turn taking across whole intervals.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Say 'Your turn' or 'Wait for your friend.'
targets.masteryCriteria: At least 85% of intervals for 3 sessions

targets.name: Share Materials with a Peer
targets.description: Hands over a block when requested.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Peer asks to borrow one shared block.

programs.baseline: Independent play averaged 75 seconds; turn taking occurred in 6 of 20 intervals.

programs.name: Spontaneous Requests
programs.programObjective: Increase unprompted requests for items and help.
programs.teachingInstructions: Arrange motivating opportunities, pause to allow initiation, and count only independently initiated requests.
programs.description: Increase unprompted requests for items and help.

targets.name: Spontaneous Two-Word Requests
targets.description: Count independent two-word requests.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Preferred item visible but out of reach.
targets.masteryCriteria: At least 15 per hour for 3 sessions

targets.name: Request Help
targets.description: Count requests for assistance without prompting.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Present a closed container containing a desired item.
targets.masteryCriteria: At least 6 per hour for 3 sessions

programs.name: Fluent Naming
programs.programObjective: Increase correct responses during timed naming opportunities.
programs.teachingInstructions: Run a timed probe, count accurate responses, and record the actual probe length in minutes.
programs.description: Increase correct responses during timed naming opportunities.

targets.name: Rapid Sight Word Naming
targets.description: Correct words during a seven-minute probe.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Present primer sight word cards and say 'Read.'

targets.name: Action Naming Fluency
targets.description: Correct action labels in three minutes.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Show action cards and say 'Name as many as you can.'

targets.name: Classroom Object Fluency
targets.description: Correct object names in five minutes.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Lay out classroom object cards; say 'Name these.'

programs.name: Following Classroom Directions
programs.programObjective: Establish a baseline for receptive directions before teaching.
programs.teachingInstructions: Give one clear direction without a second cue; record independent responses and observation intervals.
programs.description: Establish a baseline for receptive directions before teaching.

targets.name: Identify Shapes
targets.description: Independently touches the named shape.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Place three shapes and say 'Touch the circle.'

targets.name: Attend to Group Directions
targets.description: Record any attending within a partial interval.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Teacher announces a group activity.

programs.name: Greeting Familiar Adults
programs.programObjective: Respond to greetings from familiar adults without prompts.
programs.teachingInstructions: Provide a natural greeting, wait five seconds, and score the independent response.
programs.description: Respond to greetings from familiar adults without prompts.

targets.name: Respond to Hello
targets.description: Says hello or waves independently.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: A familiar adult says 'Hello, Liam.'

programs.name: Picture-Assisted Requests
programs.programObjective: Use picture exchange and speech to make functional requests.
programs.teachingInstructions: Place communication icons within reach, allow initiation, and use the assigned prompt hierarchy for exchange trials.
programs.description: Use picture exchange and speech to make functional requests.

targets.name: Exchange a Picture for Snack
targets.description: Hands over the matching icon to request.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Hold a preferred snack and display the matching picture.

targets.name: Vocal Requests
targets.description: Count independently initiated spoken requests.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Offer a choice of two activities.

targets.name: Choice-Making Notes
targets.description: Write the exact words or gesture used for the choice.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Present a preferred and neutral activity.

programs.baseline: 3 of 10 independent picture exchanges at the start of September.

programs.name: Peer Engagement
programs.programObjective: Greet peers and sustain short shared activities in different rooms.
programs.teachingInstructions: Use a peer model, fade adult prompts, and measure duration and momentary attending in group play.
programs.description: Greet peers and sustain short shared activities in different rooms.

targets.name: Greet a Peer
targets.description: Returns a greeting without a prompt.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Peer approaches and says 'Hi.'

targets.name: Shared Play
targets.description: Seconds participating in joint play.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Peer invites client to build together.

targets.name: Group Circle Attending
targets.description: Eyes/body oriented to group at the observation instant.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Teacher begins circle time.

programs.name: Community Safety Preview
programs.programObjective: Introduce safety routines after caregiver consent and baseline planning.
programs.teachingInstructions: Do not collect trials until the supervisor activates this program.
programs.description: Introduce safety routines after caregiver consent and baseline planning.

targets.name: Stop at Crosswalk
targets.description: Stops at the boundary with an adult.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: An adult approaches a marked crossing.

programs.name: Fine Motor Beading
programs.programObjective: Sustain fine motor bead placement during short activities.
programs.teachingInstructions: Pause instruction pending updated occupational therapy guidance; historical data is retained.
programs.description: Sustain fine motor bead placement during short activities.

targets.name: String Beads Independently
targets.description: Seconds of independent fine motor engagement.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Present beads and a cord.

programs.name: Daily Living Routines
programs.programObjective: Complete self-care steps and wait calmly during routine transitions.
programs.teachingInstructions: Use a visual schedule, record each independent response, and time continuous routine engagement.
programs.description: Complete self-care steps and wait calmly during routine transitions.

targets.name: Follow Dressing Sequence
targets.description: Completes the requested step independently.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Present visual dressing sequence and clothes.

targets.name: Hand-Washing Engagement
targets.description: Seconds engaged in washing sequence.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Show handwashing card at sink.

targets.name: Wait with Visual Schedule
targets.description: Waits during any part of a partial interval.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Show 'wait' icon before a transition.

programs.baseline: Needed prompts for seven of ten dressing steps.

programs.name: Community Communication
programs.programObjective: Ask for help and label useful community items.
programs.teachingInstructions: Arrange community role-play, tally spontaneous requests, and time naming probes using a count-up timer.
programs.description: Ask for help and label useful community items.

targets.name: Ask for Help in Community
targets.description: Counts independent requests for help.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: A familiar item is placed out of reach in role-play.

targets.name: Name Community Signs
targets.description: Correct sign labels in two minutes.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Show familiar street sign cards and say 'Name these.'

targets.name: Community Role-Play Notes
targets.description: Record exact words and context for requests.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Begin a simulated store visit.

programs.name: Legacy Puzzle Sorting
programs.programObjective: Retain historical sorting data for review after goals changed.
programs.teachingInstructions: Do not run new trials; the archived goal has been replaced by functional living skills.
programs.description: Retain historical sorting data for review after goals changed.

targets.name: Sort Puzzle Pieces
targets.description: Places a piece in the matching group.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Show two puzzle-piece groups and say 'Sort.'
targets.masteryCriteria: Historical goal; no new mastery evaluation

programs.name: Vocal Disruption / Screaming
programs.programObjective: Count vocalizations above conversational volume that interrupt instruction.
programs.teachingInstructions: Offer a functional break request before demand; count each episode separated by 10 seconds of quiet.
programs.description: Count vocalizations above conversational volume that interrupt instruction.

targets.name: Vocal Disruption / Screaming
targets.description: Count vocalizations above conversational volume that interrupt instruction.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: A demand is presented or access to an item is delayed.
targets.masteryCriteria: Fewer than 2 per session for 4 sessions

programs.name: Elopement / Leaving Area
programs.programObjective: Time movement beyond five feet from the assigned area without permission.
programs.teachingInstructions: Maintain line of sight; start timer on departure, stop on return, and teach asking for a break.
programs.description: Time movement beyond five feet from the assigned area without permission.

targets.name: Elopement / Leaving Area
targets.description: Time movement beyond five feet from the assigned area without permission.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Transition away from a preferred activity.

programs.name: Property Disruption
programs.programObjective: Record intervals in which materials are thrown or swept off the table.
programs.teachingInstructions: Use partial-interval recording and offer a short choice before the demand.
programs.description: Record intervals in which materials are thrown or swept off the table.

targets.name: Property Disruption
targets.description: Record intervals in which materials are thrown or swept off the table.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: A work demand is introduced.
targets.masteryCriteria: At most 1 of 12 intervals for 4 sessions

programs.name: Task Refusal
programs.programObjective: Count verbal refusal or pushing work away, separated by 10 seconds of participation.
programs.teachingInstructions: Offer a choice of task order, prompt a break request, and return to instruction after the break.
programs.description: Count verbal refusal or pushing work away, separated by 10 seconds of participation.

targets.name: Task Refusal
targets.description: Count verbal refusal or pushing work away, separated by 10 seconds of participation.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: A non-preferred task is presented.

programs.name: Drop to Floor
programs.programObjective: Time lying on the floor instead of walking with the group.
programs.teachingInstructions: Present a first/then card; stop timing after client stands and resumes walking.
programs.description: Time lying on the floor instead of walking with the group.

targets.name: Drop to Floor
targets.description: Time lying on the floor instead of walking with the group.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Transition into group instruction.

programs.name: Disruptive Vocalizations
programs.programObjective: Count whole intervals containing disruptive vocalizations.
programs.teachingInstructions: Reinforce quiet participation at each 20-second interval boundary.
programs.description: Count whole intervals containing disruptive vocalizations.

targets.name: Disruptive Vocalizations
targets.description: Count whole intervals containing disruptive vocalizations.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: Group circle starts or a peer is speaking.

programs.name: Bolting from Group
programs.programObjective: Count each departure beyond the visual boundary without permission.
programs.teachingInstructions: Use a visual boundary, rehearse staying near the adult, and count new departures after return.
programs.description: Count each departure beyond the visual boundary without permission.

targets.name: Bolting from Group
targets.description: Count each departure beyond the visual boundary without permission.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: A community group changes activities.

programs.name: Hand Biting
programs.programObjective: Time contact of teeth with hand; stop timing when contact ceases.
programs.teachingInstructions: Offer a sensory alternative and document total seconds per session.
programs.description: Time contact of teeth with hand; stop timing when contact ceases.

targets.name: Hand Biting
targets.description: Time contact of teeth with hand; stop timing when contact ceases.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: A loud noise is heard during activities.

programs.name: Repetitive Vocalizations
programs.programObjective: Mark whether repeated vocalizations occur at each observation instant.
programs.teachingInstructions: Use momentary time sampling; reinforce participation after quiet checks.
programs.description: Mark whether repeated vocalizations occur at each observation instant.

targets.name: Repetitive Vocalizations
targets.description: Mark whether repeated vocalizations occur at each observation instant.
targets.discriminativeStimuli: An adult delivers a lengthy direction.
